item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Simran's lemon setup: a copper strip and an iron strip pushed into a lemon, with wires joining the strips to an LED.

Which claim correctly judges whether this is a working Voltaic cell?

options.A: It is a working Voltaic cell if the two different metal electrodes and the lemon juice electrolyte produce a current that lights the LED.
options.B: It is a working Voltaic cell even if both strips are made of the same metal.
options.C: It is a working Voltaic cell because the LED housing is present, even if the LED stays dark.
options.D: It cannot be a Voltaic cell because lemon juice cannot act as an electrolyte.
